registration.scope: One additional E2 batch1024 trial explicitly requested after prior results. Preserve the original three-run comparison and report this as an exploratory extension, not as an originally preregistered candidate.

comparison: Exploratory E2 batch1024 extension after batch16/256/512 results. Change only training batch; retain seed42, the same initial state and frozen data, lr=0.001, evaluation batch16, max100 epochs and patience12. Equal epoch ceiling is not equal optimizer updates. Do not scale learning rate automatically or replace the prior results.
scheduling: Server only. Choose physical GPU explicitly; default refuses other compute processes. Intentional sharing requires --allow-shared-gpu in both probe and full and is recorded. Require a matching successful 1024 probe on the same GPU UUID. No automatic full training, retries, resume, stop/cleanup of other jobs, or changes to E3.
